description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art character, bald, with long pointed ears: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask: give the bald head an undercut: the sides and the back cut very short, the top left long and swept over to one side in one big wave, the same hairstyle in both views. The hair is one bright grass green, shaded only with darker greens and outlined with the same thick dark outline, with no other colours inside the hair. The long pointed ears still poke out through the hair. Do not change the face, the eyes, the body or the clothes. Keep the same chunky pixel size and the same flat shading, nothing else added, transparent background.
